canonical_title: Websites are closing their doors to AI agents
description: Recent reports indicate that a number of websites are actively restricting access by autonomous AI agents, effectively "closing their doors" to these bots that companies like OpenAI, Meta, Google, and Instinct promote for tasks such as booking reservations or shopping online.

canonical_title: RTX Spark Ignites Global Celebration as New Windows PCs Arrive
description: NVIDIA announced that RTX Spark laptops are now available from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI. The devices run Windows, include Blackwell RTX graphics, support up to 128 GB of unified memory, and ship with the full NVIDIA AI platform. Prices start at $2,399.

canonical_title: Solar surpasses nuclear power globally for first time
description: For the first time, total global solar power generation has surpassed total nuclear power generation, as reported in the article.

The tiny web‑app web‑edit (version 0.1a2) released a new feature: a "copy to clipboard" option that works for both text and image data. The app is designed for browsing and editing files in a folder across machines via Tailscale, and the new feature was added to simplify moving generated logs into a Gist.

canonical_title: NY announces game ownership bill requiring ownership rather than licensing
description: A New York state representative introduced legislation that would change video game transactions from license‑based sales to true ownership, and would obligate publishers to keep games functional after official support ends.
